name: AreaChart

props.description: Row data: one category per row with a numeric value per series.
props.name: data

props.description: Key into each datum holding the x-axis category label.
props.name: categoryKey

props.description: Paint `label` as a visible caption. Set false when a CardTitle or section heading already says it — the caption stays in the DOM as sr-only, so role=img keeps its accessible name.
props.name: showCaption

props.description: Extra context appended to the screen-reader description.
props.name: description

props.description: Canvas height preset. Ignored when `height` is set.
props.name: size

props.description: Locale-aware formatting for ticks + tooltip values.
props.name: numberFormat

props.description: Stack series areas instead of overlaying them.
props.name: stacked

props.description: Render smooth (monotone) areas instead of straight segments.
props.name: curved

related: LineChart — when only the trend line matters, not the filled magnitude.
tagline: Magnitude over an ordered category axis — overlay or `stacked` areas, optional `curved` smoothing, localized formatting + text alternative. Data-visualization graph / plot.
usage: DO import from the charts entry: `import { AreaChart } from "@godxjp/ui/charts";` (recharts optional peer required).

DO import only the chart a screen uses — `import { AreaChart } from "@godxjp/ui/charts/area-chart";` — when the `./charts` barrel should not link the whole chart family. Without the `recharts` peer the build then fails ONCE, naming the package and the fix.
DO use `stacked` to show how parts accumulate into a total over time.
DON'T overlay more than 2-3 unstacked areas — fill opacity makes dense overlays unreadable; switch to LineChart.
useCases: Cumulative volume over time (e.g. total transactions per day).
Stacked composition trend (traffic sources, revenue streams).
